description: This source file contains the implementation of an Android Fragment named AppRestrictionEnforcerFragment. It provides a UI for setting various application restrictions (boolean, string, integer, choice, multi-select, and bundle array restrictions) within an Android enterprise management context. The code manages restrictions, interacts with SharedPreferences for persistence, and updates restrictions via the DevicePolicyManager.

classes.name: AppRestrictionEnforcerFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides a user interface for setting and managing app restrictions such as boolean, string, integer, choice, multi-select, and bundles. It interacts with the Android RestrictionsManager and DevicePolicyManager to apply restrictions and persists user settings using SharedPreferences.
